g.text: EBS = Emergency Braking System (Festo VUVS, NO)
VUVS = Festo solenoid valve product family
ADC = Analog-to-Digital input · DAC = D-to-A out
ESC key = 2-wire enable on ESC (from kit)
command signals from the medulla DAC
closed by SDC relay → ESC enabled
drops on SDC open → motor cut

svg.text: 24 V coil rail (gated by SDC) → EBS

g.text: How to read: top-down kart view, top = front, bottom = rear. Components shown at their physical kart locations. Pneumatic photos are the actual Festo products in use. The SDC loop's series chain (12 V source → kill 1/2/3 → impact → remote E-stop → relay coil) is drawn as red dashed wires; opening any link drops the relay coil, which (a) opens the NO contacts that close the ESC's 2-wire key pigtail (motor cut) and (b) drops the 24 V valve-coil rail (EBS opens → emergency brake). There is no panel-mounted ignition key on this kart — the only "key" is the ESC's own 2-wire enable input from the kit.

Power architecture: Battery 48 V → Buck → 12 V (single conversion). 12 V feeds Cytron, Jetson barrel jack, SDC. The Jetson regulates its own 5 V internally and provides it on its USB-C output, which powers the medulla's ESP32. There is no kart-wide 5 V buck.
